<CustomJoint name="ground_pelvis">

					<socket_child_frame>pelvis_offset</socket_child_frame>
					
					<coordinates>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_tilt">
							
							<default_value>0</default_value>

							<range>-1.5707963300000001 1.5707963300000001</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_list">
							
							<default_value>0</default_value>
							
							<default_speed_value>0</default_speed_value>
							
							<range>-1.5707963300000001 1.5707963300000001</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_rotation">
							
							<default_value>0</default_value>
							
							<default_speed_value>0</default_speed_value>
							
							<range>-10 10</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_tx">
							
							<default_value>0</default_value>
							
							<default_speed_value>0</default_speed_value>
							
							<range>-5 5</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_ty">
							
							<default_value>0.93999999671975343</default_value>
							
							<default_speed_value>0</default_speed_value>
							
							<range>-1 2</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>
						<Coordinate name="pelvis_tz">
							
							<default_value>0</default_value>
							
							<default_speed_value>0</default_speed_value>
							
							<range>-3 3</range>
							
							<clamped>false</clamped>
							
							<locked>false</locked>
							
							<prescribed_function />
							
							<prescribed>false</prescribed>
						</Coordinate>

						<PhysicalOffsetFrame name="ground_offset">
							
							<FrameGeometry name="frame_geometry">
								
								<socket_frame>..</socket_frame>

								<Appearance>
									
									<visible>true</visible>
								</Appearance>
							</FrameGeometry>

							<translation>0 0 0</translation>
							
							<orientation>0 0 0</orientation>
						</PhysicalOffsetFrame>
						<PhysicalOffsetFrame name="pelvis_offset">
							
							<FrameGeometry name="frame_geometry">
								
								<socket_frame>..</socket_frame>
								
								<scale_factors>0.20000000000000001 0.20000000000000001 0.20000000000000001</scale_factors>
								
								<Appearance>
									
									<visible>true</visible>
								</Appearance>
							</FrameGeometry>
							
							<socket_parent>/bodyset/pelvis</socket_parent>
							
							<translation>0 0 0</translation>
							
							<orientation>0 0 0</orientation>

							<axis>1 0 0</axis>

							</LinearFunction>
						</TransformAxis>
						<TransformAxis name="rotation3">

							<axis>0 1 0</axis>
							
							<LinearFunction name="function">
								<coefficients> 1 0</coefficients>
							</LinearFunction>
						</TransformAxis>
						
						<TransformAxis name="translation1">
